rationale: The agent looked up the user and orders, but then executed a return (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing write. The user asked how much they could get back, not to process the return; the agent did not provide the refund amount or a breakdown. It’s also unclear whether the correct non-tablet items were returned, and no explicit confirmation of the specific order was obtained. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and correct final information was not given.
